The '''Honoghr system''' contained the planet of [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]] and the [[Honoghr (star)|cognominal star]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was located in the [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />
